regions.merged_text: VIRGIN-MOTHER, MARY IMMACULATE -- God's own Blessed Mother, He gives us as our Refuge and next to Himself, our divine Model in all things. With all modern equipage - including experienced and up-to-date nurses and doctors - their Orphanage could never procure actual MOTHER-LOVE for mother-less children. Jesus did this for His - not leaving them orphans - in giving His own Mother M. to us from the Cross and His disciples - us - to her.

regions.merged_text: GOOD EXAMPLE BEST OF SERMONS. Every religious of good example is "a city built on a mountain that cannot be hid." Brother Dutton who took saintly Father Damien's place with the lepers was converted by example of his . .. .Mr. Ryan. " ... I don't steal, Captain. I'm a Catholic." Ryan's answer impressed Dutton so that at once he started to look into the only science that carries into eternity, RELIGION, - Science of our happy relationship with God and our neighbor.

regions.merged_text: GRATEFUL APPRECIATION TO DIVINE PROVIDENCE. ? FOR EVERYTHING- Our existence - our faith - our vocation - Our superiors - each and all our brethen, How is it possible to thank God for having given us good faithful parents - relatives - friends - the whole universe with its details beyond created intelligence ? spirit- ually and materially!
